name: Silver Beauty-Dish High Fashion Sculpt
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Sculpt cheekbones cleanly via `centered overhead silver beauty dish light`, crisp circular catchlights, tight specular collarbones, muted slate studio backdrop, and razor garment tailoring.

name: Window Daylight + Silver Fill Candid
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Place subject beside sheer north-facing apartment window (`soft directional side wrap daylight`), lifting gentle cheek shadows subtly with reflected white sheet while distant hallway recedes dark.

name: Weathered Character Study & Life Lines
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Celebrate authentic time-etched skin relief: deep sun-weathered crow's feet, salt-crusted knit wool beanie, coarse silver beard bristles catching overcast harbor light truthfully.

name: Backstage Stagehand & Dancer Grit
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Contrast glowing warm stage spotlight spill bleeding past heavy black velvet curtains against scuffed satin pointe ribbons, resin-dusted ankles, and glistening shoulder sweat.

name: Backlit Concert Stage Haze Portrait
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Wrap silhouette intensely inside warm amber concert Fresnel flare cutting smoky club air, worn sunburst guitar lacquer gleam, damp curls, and raw honest focus.

name: Artisan Maker Hands & Workshop Story
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Frame tight waist-up across spinning stoneware wheel showing wet gray slip coating focused fingers, canvas apron dust splatters, and warm dusty barn window light.

name: Architectural Pier Under-Arch Silhouette
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Step deep beneath towering shadowed wooden pier pilings looking outward toward blazing amber surf foam, framing tiny crisp silhouettes cleanly inside dark vertical timber columns.

name: 1940s Noir Venetian Blind Shadows
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Project sharp parallel sunlight bars across smoked oak desk and sharp jawline (`classic monochrome chiaroscuro`), wisps of rising steam catching crisp diagonal slats.

name: Summer Canopy Leaf Dapple Pattern
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Cast delicate lacy organic sunlit patterns across cotton blouse and sunlit freckles through overhead fig branches (`85mm f/2.0, creamy shimmering green garden bokeh`).

name: Winter Knitwear & Warm Hearth Glow
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Emphasize chunky oatmeal cable-knit wool fuzz illuminated by low amber firelight beside frosted twilight blue pane behind.

name: Silk Kimono Gold-Thread Brocade Study
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Capture fine metallic gold-thread crane embroidery catching soft bamboo garden side-light along crisp silk folds and understated matte lacquer hairpins.

name: Matte Tactical Cordura & Mud Detail
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Describe matte Cordura weave stitching, scratched anodized aluminum rails, damp woodland mist beading along Gore-Tex shoulders, and calm focused steel-gray expression.

name: Avant-Garde Couture Silhouette Studio
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Highlight dramatic pleated organza architecture casting crisp self-shadows against neutral seamless plaster cyclorama lit by large feathered octabox.

name: Gallery Oil Impasto Palette-Knife Texture
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Keep real paint materiality intact: `rich thick oil impasto ridges, tactile linen canvas weave peaking through thin glazes, confident directional palette-knife strokes, museum chiaroscuro`.

name: Matte Storybook Gouache Warmth
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Use `velvety opaque matte gouache brushwork, sun-warmed ochre hills, crisp shadowed pine clusters, delicate dry-brush cloud edges, hand-painted illustration warmth`.

name: Atelier Charcoal & Sanguine Paper Study
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Ground medium on `warm toned laid Ingres cotton paper`: expressive compressed willow charcoal shadows, crisp white chalk highlight strokes, subtle smudged finger blend.

name: Edo Woodblock Grain & Prussian Indigo
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Preserve authentic `shin-hanga woodblock print aesthetics`: visible cherrywood grain faintly embossed in pale mist washes, crisp hand-carved keyblock contours, bokashi indigo gradations.

name: 1980s Retro Chrome Airbrush Poster
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Channel `1984 Hajime Sorayama / Syd Mead acrylic airbrush mastery`: smooth brushed specular chrome reflections, soft pastel magenta-cyan horizon airbrush fade, subtle crisp paint mask edges.

name: Architectural Isometric Miniature Cutaway
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Organize crisp `45-degree isometric cross-section diorama` showing layered oak beams, miniature glowing desk lamps, tiny bookshelf clutter, and soft ambient occlusion shadows.

name: Backlit Layered Paper-Cut Shadowbox
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Stack delicate translucent cardstock layers cleanly separated vertically so warm rear LED glow illuminates crisp fibrous paper edges down through misty valley silhouettes.

name: Crisp Cyanotype Engineering Blueprint
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Render clean `exploded orthographic engineering assembly diagram on deep Prussian blueprint stock`, razor crisp hairline dimension arrows, subtle fold crease texture.

name: Film Production Concept Matte Architecture
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Combine photographic granite textures with expressive atmospheric mist brushes: monumental brutalist hangar carved inside fjord cliff, tiny shuttle beacons giving unmistakable scale.

name: Hand-Painted Botanical Field Guide Plate
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Use `transparent layered watercolor pigment washes over fine sepia fountain-pen ink outlines` on textured cold-press cotton paper showing root, bud, and cross-section cleanly.

name: Inked Graphic Novel Chiaroscuro
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Drive bold heavy solid India-ink shadow spotting paired with crisp directional nib crosshatching and restrained muted rust/teal flat color fills.

name: Kintsugi Urushi Lacquer & Gold Seam
author: Vimona Core
system_instructions: Focus `100mm macro` tightly across dark speckled charcoal raku stoneware fractures mended delicately with gleaming dusted 24k gold urushi lacquer seams on worn cedar surface.
